brief:
Trump endorsed Benjamin Netanyahu on Sunday ahead of Israel's parliamentary election on October 27, Al-Monitor reported. The US president's backing comes as the veteran prime minister seeks a new mandate in a closely contested race.

The timing of Trump's endorsement provides political momentum to Netanyahu's campaign. The Israeli election is expected to remain competitive, with multiple parties vying for seats in the Knesset.
dek: US President Donald Trump endorsed on Sunday his ally Benjamin Netanyahu before Israel's close-fought parliamentary election on October 27, providing a boost to the veteran prime minister's bid to win a new mandate.
title: Trump endorses Netanyahu ahead of Israel's October 27 election
